declarations.body:
fun {n} u A R i j value =>
  And (LE.le.{0} i j)
    (∃ dot residual,
      And (Cholesky.SequentialDot u (Cholesky.dotInputs R i j) dot)
        (And (Cholesky.Residual u (↑i) (A i j) dot residual)
          (ite.{1} (Eq.{1} i j) (And (LE.le.{0} 0 residual) (Cholesky.Rounded u (Real.sqrt residual) value))
            (And (Ne.{1} (R i i) 0) (Cholesky.Rounded u (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} residual (R i i)) value)))))

declarations.type:
{n : Nat} →

declarations.name: Cholesky.cholesky_factorization
declarations.type:
∀ {n : Nat} (A Rhat : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (u : Real),
  Matrix.IsSymm.{0, 0} A →
    Matrix.PosDef.{0, 0} A →
      LE.le.{0} 0 u →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1)) u) 1 →
          Cholesky.SuccessfulCholesky u A Rhat →
            ∃ ΔA,
              And (Eq.{1} ΔA (Cholesky.backwardPerturbation A Rhat))
                (And (Matrix.IsSymm.{0, 0} ΔA)
                  (And (Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} Rhat) Rhat) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA))
                    (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                      LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔA i j))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Cholesky.gamma (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1) u)
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Cholesky.entrywiseAbs (Matrix.transpose.{0, 0, 0} Rhat))
                            (Cholesky.entrywiseAbs Rhat) i j)))))

      List.map.{0, 0} (fun i => Prod.mk.{0, 0} i j)
